title: Qwen3.6-27B sole-T16 Q4 narrow full-attention K/V F16 prefill

change.roles: all Q4_K full-attention K and V tensors
change.unchanged: FFN-down remains in-place; wider attention, gate/up, rows<512, decode, MTP, and peer backends remain exact

counterbalanced_full_prefill_ab.protocol: one resident model/session per board and shape; warm baseline/candidate; seven alternating baseline/candidate pairs; synchronized public prefill call

absolute_safeguard.note: Do not replace the rollup's higher FFN-only absolute median with this sub-percent increment; same-session A/B is the retained component evidence because independent load/thermal drift is larger.

decision: Retain as a byte-neutral model-scoped prefill default. The exact component win survives counterbalanced full-prefill A/B at all three contexts on both gfx1100 boards, quality passes, and decode/MTP/residency are unchanged.
